topic.title: 15 Things From the 70s You Don't See Anymore
topic.query: things from the 70s you don't see anymore
topic.angle: Shag carpet, phone booths, TV antennas, ashtrays everywhere, 8-track players: everyday objects that quietly vanished.
topic.why: Arama önerisiyle birebir eşleşiyor ('25 things from the 70s', 'no longer exist'). Nesne odaklı olduğu için görselleştirmesi çok kolay.
